lines.zh: 我摆尾慢慢巡，沟壁在两边。
lines.en: I cruise slowly, trench walls on both sides.

lines.zh: 我的鳍很硬，转弯不灵活。
lines.en: My fins are stiff and I turn poorly.

lines.zh: 我沿着沟底游，影子贴着泥。
lines.en: I swim the trench floor, shadow on the silt.

lines.zh: 冷水让我清醒，也让我慢。
lines.en: Cold water keeps me clear, and slow.

lines.zh: 我闻着水里的味道改方向。
lines.en: I follow a scent and change course.

lines.zh: 那条蟹在石缝里，我没急着去。
lines.en: That crab is in the crevice; I do not rush.

lines.zh: 我游过去，泥被我搅起一道。
lines.en: I pass and leave a line of stirred silt.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴游，水从牙间穿过。
lines.en: I swim with my mouth open, water through my teeth.

lines.zh: 沟里有鳐鱼的味道，往下走。
lines.en: Ray scent in the trench; I go deeper.

lines.zh: 我贴得太近沟壁，蹭掉一层皮。
lines.en: I hug the wall too close and scrape skin.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但从不改主意。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never change my mind.

lines.zh: 温水的沟口我不进，太亮。
lines.en: I avoid the warm trench mouth; too bright.

lines.zh: 我绕着礁石打了一个圈。
lines.en: I circle the reef once.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过泥，什么都没惊动。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the silt and disturbs nothing.

lines.zh: 我悬在沟里，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I hover in the trench, gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，泥落在我背上。
lines.en: I hold still and silt settles on my back.

lines.zh: 有只龙虾在石头下敲壳。
lines.en: A lobster taps its shell under a stone.

lines.zh: 我在算它什么时候出来。
lines.en: I am counting when it will come out.

lines.zh: 深沟里没人来，也就没架打。
lines.en: Nobody comes here, so there are no fights.

lines.zh: 我把牙露在外面，一直露着。
lines.en: My teeth stay bared; that is how I am.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转个身，脸朝暗处。
lines.en: I turn slowly to face the dark.

lines.zh: 上面有鲸的歌声，我不上去。
lines.en: A whale sings above; I do not go up.

lines.zh: 我的皮很粗，像砂纸。
lines.en: My hide is rough as sandpaper.

lines.zh: 我在等水变冷一点。
lines.en: I wait for the water to cool further.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游近又跑掉了。
lines.en: A small fish comes near and darts off.

lines.zh: 我不饿的时候也一样凶。
lines.en: I am just as mean when I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 泥里有一块骨头，我看了看。
lines.en: There is a bone in the silt; I look at it.

lines.zh: 我把身体摆正，继续等。
lines.en: I right my body and keep waiting.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和血的味道。
lines.en: You smell of iron and blood.

lines.zh: 我转过眼来看你，只转了眼睛。
lines.en: I turn an eye to you, only the eye.

lines.zh: 你游得比我快，这不重要。
lines.en: You swim faster than me; that hardly matters.

lines.zh: 我数着你身上几处伤口。
lines.en: I count the wounds on you.

lines.zh: 你被我看上，就别转身。
lines.en: Once I have marked you, do not turn your back.

lines.zh: 我在看你手里的鱼排。
lines.en: I am looking at that fish steak in your hand.

lines.zh: 你这么大，够我吃很久。
lines.en: You are large enough to feed me a long while.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就当你怕了。
lines.en: If you do not move, I take it as fear.

lines.zh: 沟里常有东西盯着人看。
lines.en: Things in the trench often stare back.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你还在动。
lines.en: I watch you because you are still moving.

lines.zh: 你身后那条鳐鱼也是我的。
lines.en: That ray behind you is mine as well.

lines.zh: 你走吧，我不追第二次。
lines.en: Leave now, and I will not chase twice.

lines.zh: 这一口撕开我的侧腹。
lines.en: That bite tears open my flank.

lines.zh: 我流着血，反而更凶。
lines.en: Bleeding, I only get meaner.

lines.zh: 我的鳍被咬掉一块，游得歪。
lines.en: A piece of fin is gone and I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 牙崩了一颗，嘴里发腥。
lines.en: A tooth has broken; my mouth tastes of blood.

lines.zh: 我的长颚被撞得缩回去。
lines.en: My long jaw snaps back from the blow.

lines.zh: 我往沟底沉，压住伤口。
lines.en: I sink to the floor and press the wound down.

lines.zh: 谁咬我，我就追到底。
lines.en: Whoever bit me, I will chase to the end.

lines.zh: 血引来别的鲨鱼，我知道。
lines.en: My blood will draw other sharks; I know.

lines.zh: 我还能咬，别靠太近。
lines.en: I can still bite; do not come close.

lines.zh: 这点伤不配让我躲。
lines.en: This wound is not worth hiding for.

lines.zh: 鱼排的血味很重，我闻到了。
lines.en: That fish steak smells strongly of blood.

lines.zh: 我朝你近了一点，就一点。
lines.en: I come a little nearer, just a little.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，抖了我就起疑。
lines.en: Do not let your hand shake; shaking makes me doubt.

lines.zh: 我咬东西从不先问。
lines.en: I never ask before biting.

lines.zh: 那块肉在往下沉，快些。
lines.en: The meat is sinking; be quicker.

lines.zh: 我慢，但我一定会到。
lines.en: I am slow, but I always arrive.

lines.zh: 你把饵举高，我不跳。
lines.en: Raise the bait high; I do not jump.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，这不算答应。
lines.en: I opened my mouth; that is not agreement.

lines.zh: 深沟里的食物都带钩。
lines.en: Everything worth eating down here has a hook.

lines.zh: 我绕一圈，从你背后过来。
lines.en: I circle around and come from behind you.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的侧腹，我晃了晃。
lines.en: You hit my flank and I rock sideways.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，你的刀才刚划开。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your blade barely opens it.

lines.zh: 别贴我的鳃，那里最软。
lines.en: Not near my gills; that is the softest part.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，把你推开半米。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail shoves you back.

lines.zh: 沟太窄，我们两个挤不过。
lines.en: The trench is too narrow for both of us.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的背，牙就在脚边。
lines.en: You stepped on my back; my teeth are at your foot.

lines.zh: 我的长吻撞歪了，血在水里散。
lines.en: My long snout is bent; blood spreads in the water.

lines.zh: 我不让路，你自己绕。
lines.en: I will not yield; go around.

lines.zh: 水被我们搅得看不清。
lines.en: Between us the water is unreadable.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就咬。
lines.en: Bump me once more and I bite.

lines.zh: 有只同类从沟那头过来。
lines.en: One of my kind comes from the far end.

lines.zh: 它比我短一点，牙一样多。
lines.en: She is shorter than me, with as many teeth.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，谁也不快。
lines.en: We swim abreast, neither hurrying.

lines.zh: 我用鳍碰它的侧腹。
lines.en: I touch her flank with my fin.

lines.zh: 它没走，我就跟了一路。
lines.en: She does not leave, so I follow a long way.

lines.zh: 深沟里同类太少，遇上是运气。
lines.en: Few of us here; meeting is luck.

lines.zh: 我们在礁石背面待了一夜。
lines.en: We stayed a night behind the reef.

lines.zh: 之后各游各的，谁也不留。
lines.en: After that we part, neither staying.

lines.zh: 小的会自己活下来，不用教。
lines.en: The young survive on their own; no teaching needed.

lines.zh: 我记着它的气味，很久。
lines.en: I remember her scent for a long time.

lines.zh: 你抓我的尾，我会转过来。
lines.en: Grab my tail and I will turn around.

lines.zh: 我太重，你抬起来就往下沉。
lines.en: I am heavy; lifting me drags you down.

lines.zh: 我在你手里挣，牙离你很近。
lines.en: I thrash in your grip, teeth near your hand.

lines.zh: 我的皮很糙，磨得你手疼。
lines.en: My hide is rough enough to hurt your hands.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃很快就合上。
lines.en: Out of water my gills close quickly.

lines.zh: 你把我拖上船，我一动不动。
lines.en: You drag me aboard and I go still.

lines.zh: 我闻到船木的味道，不喜欢。
lines.en: I smell boat wood and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我这一身肉，够你们分。
lines.en: There is enough meat on me for a crew.

lines.zh: 放我回沟里，我记账。
lines.en: Put me back in the trench and I keep accounts.

lines.zh: 我最后挣扎一下，溅你一身水。
lines.en: One last thrash soaks you through.

lines.zh: 石缝里那只蟹探出头了。
lines.en: The crab in the crevice has poked its head out.

lines.zh: 它壳很硬，可我牙更硬。
lines.en: Its shell is hard; my teeth are harder.

lines.zh: 我把身转过去，正对它。
lines.en: I turn my body square to it.

lines.zh: 有只龙虾在泥上走，慢了。
lines.en: A lobster walks the silt, too slowly.

lines.zh: 它一敲壳，我就知道位置。
lines.en: Each tap of its shell tells me where it is.

lines.zh: 鳐鱼贴着底滑，我从上方压。
lines.en: A ray skims the floor; I press from above.

lines.zh: 我盯上的东西很少跑掉。
lines.en: Few things I fix on ever get away.

lines.zh: 这只不大，先拿来垫肚子。
lines.en: This one is small; it will do for now.

lines.zh: 我不挑，蟹和虾都行。
lines.en: I am not choosy; crab or shrimp both.

lines.zh: 它受伤了，血腥味很浓。
lines.en: It is wounded and the blood smells strong.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往下沉，不惊动它。
lines.en: I sink slowly so as not to startle it.

lines.zh: 沟壁挡住了它的退路。
lines.en: The trench wall has cut off its retreat.

lines.zh: 我选定它了，别的都放下。
lines.en: I have chosen it; the rest can wait.

lines.zh: 它还在那儿，我就有饭。
lines.en: It is still there, so I still have a meal.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，鳍几乎贴泥。
lines.en: I flatten myself, fins nearly on the silt.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的头就跟着偏。
lines.en: When it moves, my head shifts with it.

lines.zh: 我算着它到石缝的距离。
lines.en: I measure its distance to the crevice.

lines.zh: 再等它出来半只身子。
lines.en: I wait for half of it to emerge.

lines.zh: 水里的味道指向它，很准。
lines.en: The scent points straight at it.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大，不发出声。
lines.en: I open my mouth widest, making no sound.

lines.zh: 它开始往回缩了，得快。
lines.en: It is retreating; I must be quick.

lines.zh: 我贴着沟壁绕，避开正面。
lines.en: I slide along the wall, off its front.

lines.zh: 它的钳子对着我，先不管。
lines.en: Its claws face me; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经就位了。
lines.en: My teeth are already in place.

lines.zh: 这次我不留余地。
lines.en: This time I leave nothing to chance.

lines.zh: 它停住了，是最好的时机。
lines.en: It has stopped; this is the best moment.

lines.zh: 我从它侧面来，它看不见。
lines.en: I come from its blind side.

lines.zh: 我绷紧全身，只等一步。
lines.en: I coil tight and wait for one step.

lines.zh: 我把吻部往前送，牙先露出。
lines.en: I push my snout forward and bare the teeth first.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，泥都翻了。
lines.en: I bite down and the silt turns over.

lines.zh: 它壳在我牙间裂开。
lines.en: Its shell splits between my teeth.

lines.zh: 它钳我嘴，我不松口。
lines.en: It pinches my snout; I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它从石缝拖出来。
lines.en: I shake my head and drag it from the crevice.

lines.zh: 血在水里拉出一条线。
lines.en: Blood draws a line through the water.

lines.zh: 龙虾的尾拍我脸，很疼。
lines.en: The lobster's tail slaps my face and stings.

lines.zh: 我咬第二口，这次更深。
lines.en: I bite again, deeper this time.

lines.zh: 它挣断了半只钳跑掉。
lines.en: It tears off half a claw and escapes.

lines.zh: 剩下的我慢慢吃，不着急。
lines.en: I eat the rest slowly, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 有鲨鱼来抢，我转身就撞。
lines.en: A shark comes to steal; I turn and ram it.

lines.zh: 我受了一击就还一击，不忍。
lines.en: Hit me once and I hit back, never forgiving.

lines.zh: 牙断了也还在咬。
lines.en: Even with a broken tooth I keep biting.

lines.zh: 这条沟里我的牙最长。
lines.en: In this trench my teeth are the longest.

lines.zh: 打完我退回暗处，等伤口合。
lines.en: Done, I withdraw to the dark to heal.

lines.zh: 我从沟底的卵里挣出来。
lines.en: I break out of an egg on the trench floor.

lines.zh: 一出生牙就长齐了。
lines.en: My teeth were full grown at birth.

lines.zh: 我身下是泥，头顶是黑水。
lines.en: Silt below me, black water above.

lines.zh: 沟壁很高，我绕着它游。
lines.en: The wall is high; I circle it.

lines.zh: 周围没有同类，只有冷。
lines.en: No kin around me, only cold.

lines.zh: 我第一次咬住的是一只小蟹。
lines.en: The first thing I bit was a small crab.

lines.zh: 那味道我到现在还记得。
lines.en: I remember that taste to this day.

lines.zh: 我一天天长，牙一层层换。
lines.en: I grow, and my teeth replace in rows.

lines.zh: 这条沟的规矩由牙来定。
lines.en: In this trench, teeth make the rules.

lines.zh: 我往深的地方去，那里有食。
lines.en: I head deeper, where the food is.

lines.zh: 有东西在看我，我看见了。
lines.en: Something watches me; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，它退开了。
lines.en: I open my mouth and it backs off.

lines.zh: 我从不躲，最多绕一圈。
lines.en: I never hide, at most I circle once.

lines.zh: 现在这条沟归我一半。
lines.en: Half of this trench is mine now.

lines.zh: 海沟的冷水里，我先动了一下。
lines.en: In the cold trench water, I stir first.

lines.zh: 这片泥底上，没有别的牙印。
lines.en: There are no other tooth marks in this mud.

lines.zh: 火的热透进水里，我皮都卷了。
lines.en: Fire's heat reaches through water and curls my hide.

lines.zh: 我从沟壁掉下去，撞在石上。
lines.en: I drop off the wall and hit stone.

lines.zh: 我的鳃在空气里张着，没用。
lines.en: My gills gape in the air and do nothing.

lines.zh: 炸力在水里推我撞上岩壁。
lines.en: The blast shoves me into the rock.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我背鳍的根部。
lines.en: An arrow lodges at the base of my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 那股力钻进鳃缝，我抽了一下。
lines.en: That force slips into my gills and I jerk.

lines.zh: 饿到极处，我开始咬石头。
lines.en: Hungry past bearing, I bite at stone.

lines.zh: 电在水里散开，我的牙都在抖。
lines.en: Current spreads through water and my teeth chatter.

lines.zh: 沟底没有了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The trench floor is gone and I fall.
